description: This file contains unit tests for the `LocalizationService` class, testing various localization functionalities, error handling, and XML processing related to language packages in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing `LocalizationService` functions including translations, error handling, and XLIF file processing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes `LocalizationService`, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of date format options returned by `getLocalizationDateFormats()`.

methods.name: testGetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Checks the supported languages list returned by `getSupportedLanguages()`.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests language search functionality via `searchLanguages()`.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Verifies the correct conversion of language entities to country arrays for UI.

methods.name: testGenerateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Tests the generation of language string keys using `generateLangStringLanguageKey()`.

methods.name: testExportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Checks retrieval of language groups for export via `getLocalizationDao()->searchGroups()`.

methods.name: testGetXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Validates the correctness of retrieved XLIF XML content, including structure and language data, for different language IDs.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForInvalidSyntaxTest
methods.description: Creates a mock of `LocalizationService` that returns an `INVALID_SYNTAX` error for testing validation behavior.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithInvalidSyntaxString
methods.description: Ensures validation catches invalid syntax in target strings.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForValidateLangStringTesting
methods.description: Creates a mock `LocalizationService` set up with a specific language string value and optional error for validation testing.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholders
methods.description: Tests validation passes when string has no placeholders.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholdersError
methods.description: Tests validation detects placeholder mismatch error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholders
methods.description: Validates correct matching of placeholders in target string.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholdersInDifferentOrder
methods.description: Ensures placeholders in different order still pass validation.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPlaceholders
methods.description: Detects placeholder mismatch when placeholders differ.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPluralString
methods.description: Validates proper handling of plural forms.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralCategories
methods.description: Checks validation with various plural categories.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutOtherPluralCategory
methods.description: Detects error if other plural category is missing.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects error when the plural variable name is missing or mismatched.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects mismatched plural variables in strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithSelectVariable
methods.description: Validates select variable usage in strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectOtherCategory
methods.description: Detects missing 'other' category in select strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects missing select variable in strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects mismatch in select variables.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of I18N errors by name.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorWithInvalidErrorName
methods.description: Checks handling of invalid error name request, expecting exception.

methods.name: testLanguageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks detection of import errors for a language.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Verifies cleaning of import errors for specific language strings.

methods.name: getBase64AttachmentForTestingProcessXliff
methods.description: Prepares a `Base64Attachment` with specified XLIFF content for testing `processXliffFile()`.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyContent
methods.description: Tests exception handling when processing an empty XLIF file.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidContent
methods.description: Checks validation failure detection for malformed XLIF XML.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidVersion
methods.description: Ensures version mismatch in XLIF causes failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Ensures missing version attribute causes failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingSourceLanguage
methods.description: Detects missing source language in XLIF.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Detects missing target language in XLIF.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidTargetLanguageForLanguageId
methods.description: Ensures invalid target language code causes failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyTargetString
methods.description: Verifies behavior when target strings are empty; expects skipping.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithValidAndInvalidTargetStrings
methods.description: Tests processing mix of valid and invalid translations.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidLangStrings
methods.description: Checks detection of invalid placeholders/formats within language strings during XLIF processing.
